meta.title: Playa la Malagueta
meta.description: Complete guide to Playa la Malagueta in Málaga. Learn about this iconic Andalusian beach, its location, visiting information, and travel tips.

intro.title: Discover Playa la Malagueta
intro.description: Playa de la Malagueta is one of the most iconic urban beaches in Málaga, located on the Paseo Marítimo Pablo Ruiz Picasso. With its characteristic toneleras (wooden kiosks), this golden sand beach offers a perfect environment to enjoy the sun and the Mediterranean Sea, being a favorite destination for both locals and tourists.

visitGuide.title: Visit Tips
items: The beach is accessible year-round and admission is free.
Ideal for enjoying the sun and swimming in the Mediterranean.
Features traditional toneleras and dining services.

sections.title: Historical Background
sections.content: Playa de la Malagueta has been for decades one of the main meeting points in Málaga. Its name comes from the La Malagueta neighborhood, and it has become a symbol of the Málaga coast, being a pioneer in implementing urban beach services in the city.

sections.title: Location & Layout
sections.content: The beach is located on the Paseo Marítimo Pablo Ruiz Picasso, in the Málaga-Este area. It features a wide maritime promenade ideal for walking, bike lane, rest areas, and an excellent offer of chiringuitos and restaurants facing the sea.

sections.title: Cultural Significance
sections.content: As one of the most popular urban beaches on the Costa del Sol, La Malagueta is the scene of numerous summer events, sports activities, and social gatherings, being a reference point for Málaga's coastal identity.

sections.title: Services & Facilities
sections.content: The beach features sun loungers and umbrellas, showers, lifeguard post, dining areas in the toneleras, bicycle rental, and access for people with reduced mobility. The promenade offers ample areas for leisure and sports.

hours.title: Visiting Hours
hours.bestTimeSpring: Spring: Pleasant temperatures, ideal for walking
hours.tip: The beach is accessible 24 hours a day, although tonelera services and lifeguards operate during the summer season.

tickets.title: Admission Information
tickets.parkingPrice: Parking available on the promenade (paid during high season)
tickets.servicesPrice: Sun loungers and umbrellas for rent

transport.title: How to Get Here
transport.fromCenterDesc: The beach is accessible on foot from the center (approx. 20 min) or by urban bus.
transport.fromStationDesc: Accessible by urban bus or on foot from María Zambrano station.
transport.fromAirportDesc: From Málaga-Costa del Sol Airport, you can take the C1 train or a taxi to the center.
transport.publicTransportDesc: Well connected by Málaga urban bus network, with stops nearby.
transport.walkingDesc: Accessible on foot from multiple areas of the city, ideal for walking along the promenade.
transport.drivingDesc: Accessible by car, with parking options on the promenade.

route.title: Recommended Route
route.overview: Enjoy a pleasant walk along the coast and its surroundings.
steps: Start at Paseo Marítimo Pablo Ruiz Picasso
Enjoy the golden sand and Mediterranean Sea
Walk along the bike lane by the sea
Enjoy local gastronomy at the chiringuitos

items.name: Carlos M.
items.text: An exceptional urban beach. I always come here to relax and walk. It's a wonderful place for families and friends.

items.name: Laura G.
items.text: The perfect place to enjoy the sun and sea. The promenade is spectacular and the toneleras very cozy.

items.name: Antonio R.
items.text: A beautiful and well-located beach. Ideal for evening or morning walks. I warmly recommend it to everyone visiting Málaga.

items.name: María S.
items.text: Being a sea lover, I was deeply impressed by the water quality and relaxed atmosphere of this beach. A true corner of peace.

items.name: José L.
items.text: Excellent place for family walks. The promenade is very well maintained and the atmosphere is very relaxing.

items.name: Carmen T.
items.text: Compared to other beaches, this one offers a quiet refuge near the center. The feeling of peace and the sea make it one of my favorite places.

officialManagement.title: About Playa la Malagueta
officialManagement.text: Playa de la Malagueta is an iconic urban beach in Málaga, Spain, being a perfect example of combining nature with urban leisure on the Andalusian coast. The area is jointly managed for environmental protection and daily operations by the Málaga City Council and related tourism and environmental departments.
